title: refactor(Formalism/HermitianCurvature): remove duplicated Ux10 chart and Lie helpers in PhiBoundPartsOfRadicalParametrisation
body:
Remove the duplicated Cayley-chart, Lie-basis, and matrix-smoothness block from `PhiBoundPartsOfRadicalParametrisation.lean` (`Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.Ux10`), promote its existing import of `CompactlySupportedBanachModel.lean` (`Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.Ux1`) to `public import`, and update all callers (`CellSmoothness.lean`, `ChartIntegralLocal.lean`, `CutNFLeib.lean`, `DerivativeRulesA1.lean`, `IntegrableCsmul.lean`, `PartialBesselSmoothCompactSupport.lean`, `SmoothLevOfCk.lean`, and `SmoothWordsAll.lean`) to use `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.Ux1` directly.

Removed duplicate declarations in `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.Ux10` (replaced by the identical declarations in `Formalism.FourierDecayAlt.P.Ux1`):
- `cdm_iff`, `cdm_mul`, `cd_det`, `cdm_updateRow`, `cdm_inv`, `cdm_conjT`, `cdm_prj`
- `hpk_herm`, `hpk_sq'`, `prj`, `prj_lie`, `prj_of_lie`, `prj_add`, `prj_rsmul`, `prj_zero`, `prj_sum`
- `kap`, `iot`, `kap_mem`, `iot_facts`
- `J`, `Eb`, `Mv`, `co`, `Mv_co`, `Mv_sum`, `co_add`, `co_smul`, `co_zero`, `co_sum`, `cd_co`, `cd_Mv`
- `Lt`, `Lt_unit`, `prj_Eb`, `kc`, `expandL`, `kc_sum`
- `chart`, `Dom`, `cd_prjMv`, `dom_open`, `zero_mem_dom`, `chart_cd`, `chart_mem`, `chart_diff`
- `mulB`, `mulB_apply`, `cT`, `cT_apply`, `tangent`, `ebv`, `sC`, `aC`, `aC_apply`, `aC_cd`
- `hasFDeriv_chart`, `cont_chart`, `rho`, `Sr`, `sr_open`, `rho_cd`
